Visit note | 2025-09-15 10:00 AM | Dr. Mostafizur Rahman, Orthopedics | Patient: Ishrat Faruque, 63, female. This is a follow-up visit for review of an existing problem. Mrs. Faruque reports a creaking knee and stiffness in the morning for a few minutes, which became worse after a long sightseeing trip on foot in Motijheel. She works as a tailor and lives in Dhaka. She has no significant comorbidity. On examination: BMI 30.4, BP 131/73 mmHg, pulse 72 bpm, weight 87 kg. Joint movement is crepitant with mild limitation. Assessment: Knee osteoarthritis. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to do thigh-strengthening exercises daily, lose weight, and avoid squatting and sitting cross-legged on the floor. Follow-up in 6 weeks with physiotherapy.

Visit note | 2025-09-15 10:00 AM | Dr. Towhid Alam, ENT | Patient: Rashid Awal, 31, male. Mr. Awal attends for his first visit complaining of a sore throat, swollen glands in the neck, and fever. He mentions that his symptoms began after shouting at a cricket match in Bogura. He works as a photographer and lives in Dhaka. He reports no known chronic illnesses or prior major medical conditions. He denies earache, difficulty breathing, or rash. On examination: temperature 101.9°F, BP 125/81 mmHg, pulse 99 bpm, weight 85 kg. The pharynx is erythematous with enlarged, tender tonsils and palpable submandibular lymph nodes. Clear chest sounds bilaterally. Assessment: Acute tonsillitis. Plan: a prescription was issued today. He was advised to gargle with warm salt water, eat soft food, and drink plenty of fluids. Follow-up in 1 week.
